class CandidateModel(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_sizes, dense_dim, emb_dim=12, hidden=96, dropout=0.1, **kwargs):
        super(CandidateModel, self).__init__()
        self.embeddings = torch.nn.ModuleList([torch.nn.Embedding(vocab_size, emb_dim) for vocab_size in vocab_sizes])
        self.fc1 = torch.nn.Linear(len(vocab_sizes) * emb_dim + dense_dim, hidden)
        self.dropout = torch.nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.fc2 = torch.nn.Linear(hidden, 1)
    def forward(self, cats, dense, history=None):
        embedded = [self.embeddings[i](cats[:, i]) for i in range(cats.size(1))]
        embedded = torch.cat(embedded, dim=1)
        x = torch.cat([embedded, dense], dim=1)
        x = torch.relu(self.fc1(x))
        x = self.dropout(x)
        logits = self.fc2(x)
        return logits.squeeze(1)
